name: web-game-platformer
description: Duck Stomp - a 2D pixel platformer in the browser. No install, no account, exactly two controls.

scripts.check: pnpm lint:core && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.verify: pnpm lint:core && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.release:notes: pnpm dlx git-cliff@2.13.1 --unreleased --tag $(pnpm dlx git-cliff@2.13.1 --bumped-version) --strip all
